What Touchingz does

A B2B food production partner for modern foodservice and retail

Touchingz is a B2B snack and meal producer specialising in authentic Kerala tea-time favourites, quick bites, sandwiches and curated office meals. A food company built for the modern consumer without losing the soul of traditional cooking.

  • Fresh and clean-label production for cafés, restaurants, hotels and office clients.
  • Dependable supply for parties, events, retail counters and corporate food programs.
  • ISO 9001:2015 certified, HACCP-aligned and FSSAI-guided production approach.
  • Hybrid model: cloud kitchen innovation + packaged food scalability.
PURE

Clear ingredients, honest taste and recipes rooted in real food.

CLEAN

Minimal processing, hygiene-led kitchens and transparent sourcing.

CRAFTED

Small-batch preparation with care, consistency and culinary discipline.

The promise: fresh, safe, consistent food that looks handmade but runs with professional discipline.

Quality

Food Safety Is Not a Department. It Is the System.

ISO 9001:2015 certified, HACCP-aligned and FSSAI-guided operations create trust at scale.

Ingredient Intake

Supplier checks, expiry review, freshness inspection and rejection control.

Preparation Hygiene

Hairnets, masks, hand-wash discipline, clean utensils and work-zone separation.

Temperature Discipline

Hot/cold holding, chilled storage, batch timing and dispatch temperature checks.

Packing Control

Product labels, date/time coding, allergen notes and client-ready packs.

Traceability

Batch records, consumption logs, complaints handling and corrective action.

Our Kitchen

A dedicated production kitchen, built for clean small-batch cooking

Touchingz food is not made in a cramped back room or a home kitchen. It is made in our own purpose-built production kitchen: a spacious, brightly lit hall laid out for cooking, preparation, washing and storage. We cook in small batches so every tray gets full attention and tastes the way it should.

Space to work cleanly

A large, high-ceilinged hall with bright lighting and smooth, light-coloured surfaces that are easy to keep clean.

Stainless steel throughout

Work tables, burners, sinks and the exhaust hood are stainless steel, so they can be scrubbed down after every batch.

Dedicated wash stations

A row of sinks for hand-washing and utensil cleaning, kept apart from the cooking line.

Separate zones

Cooking, preparation, washing and storage each have their own area, so raw, cooked and packed food don't cross paths.

Cold storage on site

Chest freezers and a refrigerator keep ingredients and prepared items at the right temperature.

Safety built in

Fire extinguishers on the walls, organised racks for utensils and stores, and clocks to keep batch timing on track.

Small batches. Full attention.

Each day's batches are sized to confirmed orders, so food is cooked fresh rather than in bulk and held. Every batch follows the same recipe, the same hygiene routine and the same checks.

Clean label

Our Ingredient Philosophy

Simple, recognisable and responsibly sourced ingredients. Touchingz avoids the trap of over-processing. We use traditional culinary methods, real spices and controlled preparation instead of relying on artificial shortcuts.

  • No unnecessary artificial preservatives where fresh/frozen systems can solve shelf-life.
  • Transparent recipes with clear ingredient logic.
  • Regional flavours built from spices, herbs, coconut, banana leaf and authentic cooking techniques.
  • Supplier relationships that support quality, consistency and traceability.
Dependable supply is a product feature
Operating model & fulfilment

A Dependable Supply Partner

Designed to reduce client kitchen workload while improving menu availability and quality consistency. The model is built around predictable production, clean packing and on-time dispatch, so clients can plan their menu with confidence.

  • Menu planning and item selection
  • Forecast-based production scheduling and a kitchen production calendar
  • Daily order cut-off discipline
  • Portion control, standardised and batch-wise packing
  • Dispatch windows, delivery discipline and temperature-aware handling
  • Client feedback loop, with returns and feedback escalation
